definitions.full: H6572. parshegen or pathshegen מַּרְשֶׁ֫גֶן noun masculine copy (loan-word from Perssian through Aramaic, see Biblical Aramaic); — construct ׳פ הַנִּשְׁתְּוָן Ezra 7:11 , compare מַּתְשֶׁגֶן . מַּתְשֶׁ֫גֶן noun masculine copy ( = מַּרְשֶׁנֶן q. v.); — construct ׳מּ (הַ)כְּתָב Est 3:14 ; 4:8 ; 8:13 .
